_readme: LAW 7 layer 3 (PROJECT_RULES.md, owner amendment 2026-09-13): the project's OWN licensed real photographs,
used for German A1 vocabulary slides only when Exa (402) and Gemini (429) are both unavailable.
This file is the provenance record, not a wish list. An entry is only used when ALL of these hold:
· the file actually exists in public/real-german/
· it is a real image whose long side is >= 1080px and area >= 700,000px (the same bar every other layer passes)
· `depicts` says what is really in the photograph
· `license` says under what right it may be used (owner-shot, CC0, a purchased stock licence id, ...)
Anything short of that is skipped and the build STOPS per LAW 7 layer 4, rather than shipping a generic stand-in.
Keys are the vocabulary item's German text exactly as written in lib/german-a1.mjs (`de`),
e.g. "Was kostet das?" — matching is whitespace- and case-insensitive.
There are 100 vocabulary items across the 24 A1 units; add entries as licensed photographs are acquired.
Example of a complete entry (delete this block when adding the first real one):
"depicts": "a shopper holding a price tag in a supermarket aisle",
